title: Quantization Variant Cataloging, Version Pinning, and Drift-Watch Toolkit
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a robust ingestion and cataloging flow for quantized model artifacts (INT8, FP8, GPTQ, AWQ), attach canonical performance fingerprints, and surface pinning metadata so product and Platform can bind model variants to customer routes. Add a lightweight continuous 'drift-watch' that detects perf regressions vs published fingerprints and triggers automated quarantine or annotation flows.
implementation_steps: Define canonical quant variant metadata schema (quant_type, bitwidth, tokenizer_hash, kernel_hint, sequence_perf_profile, sample_latency_p50/p95, accuracy_delta_on_eval_suite)
Enhance artifact ingest pipeline to extract binary fingerprints + perf traces during calibration test harness
Produce a signed 'variant manifest' artifact stored in model-catalog with semantic versioning and immutable hash
Extend model-catalog API to expose 'pinnable' versions and pin-propagation headers for routing service
Wire release manager and rollout service to honor pinned variant in traffic-splits and override smart routing fallbacks
Implement Drift-Watch microservice: periodic sample reruns (mini-evals) against published fingerprint; compare metrics and emit incidents when deviation thresholds exceeded
Publish UI/Console view: variant lineage, pinned routes, recent drift alerts, and quick unpin/rollback actions
Add telemetry and SLO checks to ensure smoke checks run within budgeted tokens and time windows
acceptance_criteria: A variant manifest can be generated and uploaded for INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ artifacts and is queryable from model-catalog
Routing honors pin header for a test route and serves the exact pinned artifact under runtime-2.4 release
Drift-Watch detects a synthetic perf regression injected into the harness and raises an alert to the console with an attached regression report
Variant manifest contains required fields (quant_type, model_hash, kernel_hint, perf_snapshot) and is immutable once published
Documentation + quickstart for Solutions on how to pin a variant to a Dedicated pool exists in the Confluence doc linked below
testing_plan: Build a small testbed that registers a golden FP8 variant and a perturbed variant. Drive 1k synthetic inference calls across both, validate manifest-reported latency/accuracy vs observed, then flip a pin and assert routing, and finally simulate drift by introducing noise in perturbed artifact and assert Drift-Watch flags it within 30 minutes.
rollout_plan: Feature-flag catalog API changes and Drift-Watch in staging; enable variant-manifests for a small set of internal customers first. After 2 weeks of stable smoke checks, open to broader internal fleets, then GA. Provide migration doc for existing pinned_by_commit workflows.
risks: False positives from Drift-Watch could create unnecessary rollbacks — mitigate by tunable thresholds and multi-metric corroboration
Ingest overhead during calibration may increase CI time — mitigate by sampling and optional lightweight fingerprint mode
Pinned variants circumvent smart routing cost optimizations; need billing and quota annotations when pin active
Backward compatibility: older runtime clients might ignore new manifest headers — add graceful fallback and feature gating
